Name: Qmi's Alternate Portraits
Author: Qmina
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/Nt8eSGR.png[/img][/center]
[center][color=#faaa2e][b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=5]✨ Qmi's Alternate Portraits ✨[/size][/font][/b][/color]

[size=3]I have recently started editing the standard Stardew Valley portraits into something that is a bit more my style, since I personally didn't really fancy the original portraits. I still tried to keep them fairly similar and in the same style as the original portraits.[/size]
[size=3]Today I decided I'd share them with the internet incase there's anyone else out there that would like to use my alternate portraits too.[/size]

[size=3]This portrait mod is heavily inspired by [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/50885611]ohodavi[/url][size=3]'s [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]anime mod[/url][size=3]![/size]

[size=3]Every portrait included in this mod can be toggled ON/OFF, so if there's something you don't like you can open up the [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][size=3]﻿ in-game, search for this mod, search for the character portrait, and toggle it off.[/size]



[b][color=#6aa84f][size=4]COMPATABILITIES:[/size][/color][/b]
[size=3]Should in theory be compatible with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18345]Clint Dating Mod[/url]﻿ [color=#ffd966][b](not tested)[/b][/color][/size]
[size=3]Should in theory be compatible with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15532]Caroline Dating Mod[/url]﻿ [color=#ffd966][b](not tested)[/b][/color][/size]
[size=3]Should in theory be compatible with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]Wizard Dating Mod[/url]﻿ [color=#ffd966][b](not tested)[/b][/color][/size]

Replace the existing files in ...\Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits with these ones
For the alt portraits, check the other folders
Recommended to backup original files
